name: comp-150

frames.best_why: A clean crescent moon on the tile shows the switched-to dark state with no cursor over it.

tagline: One square tile where a sun swaps to a moon to flip the theme.
summary: A compact icon tile that toggles light and dark appearance. It shows a sun while light and a crescent moon while dark, swapping the two with a quick scale and fade.
appearance: A small rounded square tile with a thin outline sits on a near-black stage beneath a bold legend line, holding a single white sun glyph. Once switched, the same tile shows a crescent moon.
behaviour: Clicking the tile scales and fades the sun out as the moon scales in, and a second click reverses it. The tile lightens underneath on hover and draws a ring when focused from the keyboard.
search_phrases: dark mode switch with sun and moon
use_when: A site needs one compact control to switch between light and dark appearance.
avoid_when: It only flips its own icon state and never applies or stores a theme, so you must wire that yourself.
customise: No props: the legend, the sun and moon icons and the fixed tile size are in the file, and the toggle keeps only its own theme flag.
weight_why: One hidden checkbox and two 16px icons with a short scale transition.

a11y.note: The label announces the mode it will switch to and focus rings clearly, but the icon transition ignores reduced-motion.

polish_why: Small neat sun-to-moon swap; otherwise a plain outlined square button.
